description: An exhilarating 11-day adventure trip to New York City, packed with outdoor activities, scenic views, and unique experiences. Explore the city's natural side with bike tours, mountain hikes, ziplining, and kayaking, balanced with cultural insights and relaxation.

days.title: Arrival in New York & City Introduction
days.description: Arrive in New York, check into your hotel, and take some time to settle in. Enjoy a relaxed evening to prepare for the adventures ahead.

days.title: Central Park Bike Adventure
days.description: Start your adventure with a private bike tour, exploring the iconic Central Park and its hidden gems.

activities.activity_name: New York Bike Tour — Private Edition
activities.notes: What you'll see: You'll see the iconic landmarks and hidden paths within Central Park on a private guided bike tour. What to bring: Bring comfortable clothing, closed-toe shoes, water, and a camera. What to eat: Enjoy a casual lunch at a cafe near Central Park after your ride. Good to know: This private tour offers a personalized experience of the park.

days.title: Mountain Hike & Scenic Views
days.description: Embark on a refreshing mountain hike to discover stunning viewpoints around New York.

activities.address: Lower East Side, New York, United States
activities.notes: What you'll see: You'll see picturesque landscapes and panoramic views from various mountain viewpoints near New York. What to bring: Wear sturdy hiking boots, bring plenty of water, snacks, sunscreen, and a hat. What to eat: Pack a picnic lunch to enjoy amidst nature or find a local eatery after your hike. Good to know: This hike is suitable for active travellers and offers a great escape from the city bustle.

days.title: Zipline and Ropes Course Thrills
days.description: Experience an adrenaline rush with a zipline and ropes adventure course.

activities.notes: What you'll see: You'll see challenging obstacles and thrilling ziplines as you navigate the adventure course. What to bring: Wear comfortable athletic clothing and closed-toe shoes, and tie back long hair. What to eat: Grab a quick and energizing snack before or after your adventure. Good to know: Safety briefings and equipment are provided for this exciting experience.

days.title: Kayaking the New York Coastline
days.description: Explore the New York coastline from a unique perspective with a kayaking tour.

activities.address: Lower East Side, New York, United States
activities.notes: What you'll see: You'll see the New York City skyline and coastline from the water, offering unique photo opportunities. What to bring: Wear swimwear or quick-drying clothes, a hat, sunscreen, and water shoes. What to eat: Enjoy fresh seafood or a casual meal at a waterfront restaurant after your tour. Good to know: This tour is suitable for active travellers and provides all necessary kayaking equipment.

days.title: Snorkelling Day Trip
days.description: Escape the city for a day of snorkelling and discover underwater wonders.

activities.activity_name: Snorkelling Day Trip from New York
activities.notes: What you'll see: You'll see diverse marine life and underwater landscapes during your snorkelling excursion. What to bring: Bring your swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, and a change of clothes. What to eat: A packed lunch or snacks are recommended for the day trip, or check for available options at the destination. Good to know: Snorkelling gear is typically provided, and this trip is great for adventure seekers.

days.title: Countryside Escape
days.description: Take a day trip to the New York countryside for a change of scenery and fresh air.

activities.notes: What you'll see: You'll see charming rural landscapes, small towns, and natural beauty outside of the bustling city. What to bring: Comfortable walking shoes, a camera, and layers of clothing for changing weather. What to eat: Enjoy a meal at a local restaurant in the countryside, experiencing regional flavors. Good to know: This day trip offers a relaxing break and a different perspective of the region.

days.title: City Sightseeing & Culture
days.description: Balance the adventure with some classic New York sightseeing and cultural exploration.

activities.activity_name: New York Hop-On Hop-Off Bus Pass
activities.address: Lower East Side, New York, United States
activities.notes: What you'll see: You'll see major landmarks and attractions across New York City at your own pace. What to bring: Bring your camera, comfortable shoes for walking, and a map of the bus routes. What to eat: Hop off at any stop to enjoy a meal or snack at a local eatery. Good to know: This pass offers flexibility to explore the city's highlights.

activities.activity_name: New York Museum & Gallery Pass — Small Group Edition
activities.notes: What you'll see: You'll see a curated selection of art and historical exhibits in various museums and galleries. What to bring: Bring a small bag for personal items and wear comfortable shoes for walking through exhibits. What to eat: Many museums have cafes, or you can find a restaurant nearby for dinner. Good to know: This small group pass allows for a more intimate cultural experience.

days.title: Historic Walking Tour & Local Flavors
days.description: Delve into New York's rich history with a walking tour and explore local culinary delights.

activities.activity_name: Historic New York City Walking Tour
activities.notes: What you'll see: You'll see historic neighborhoods, significant landmarks, and learn about New York City's past. What to bring: Wear comfortable walking shoes, bring water, and a camera. What to eat: Explore local eateries and try some classic New York street food or a deli sandwich. Good to know: This tour provides a fascinating insight into the city's heritage.

days.title: Leisure Day & Last Minute Adventures
days.description: Enjoy a free day for last-minute souvenir shopping, revisiting a favorite spot, or discovering something new.

days.title: Departure from New York
days.description: Enjoy a final New York breakfast before heading to the airport for your return flight.
